findings.summary: Logger.mu is now held while the formatter runs, and the mutex isn't reentrant, so a custom Formatter that calls back into the logger (logging, SetOutput, SetFormatter, SetLevel, AddHook) will deadlock.
Holding the lock during formatting serializes formatting across all goroutines, which reduces throughput with slow formatters.
TestEntryReportCallerRace and TestEntryFormatterRace start goroutines without waiting for them (no sync.WaitGroup), so the tests may finish before the race occurs and -race may never detect it.
The comment says 'logging before SetReportCaller', but TestEntryFormatterRace has no SetReportCaller call (a copy-paste leftover), and 'likelyhood' is misspelled.
The same misleading 'logging before SetReportCaller' comment appears in a test with no SetReportCaller call, and 'likelyhood' is misspelled.
